A terrestrial '''world''' was home to a [[Unidentified bustling city|city]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Friends" /> During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TalesDate|U2}}</ref> the [[Theelin]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Latts Razzi]] and her companion [[C-21 Highsinger]] hunted and [[Death|killed]] a [[Unidentified four-armed alien|four-armed alien]] on the world.<ref name="Friends" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The world appeared in "[[Friends]]," the second episode of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld]]''.<ref name="Friends" />
